audit.summary: The 320x480 ad displays correct LEGO branding, French copy, and proper frame dimensions. However, there are two blockers: (1) the product hero images lack proper visual hierarchy and appear small/cramped relative to the frame, reducing impact; (2) the tagline text (e.g. 'Sèts exclusifs & collections fraîches', 'Lifestyle, fêtes & saveurs en LEGO') uses serif styling that conflicts with the LEGO Cera Pro typography system. Additionally, the carousel mechanic (initial → animated → settled states) suggests interaction that is not clearly indicated to users via visual cues (no visible pagination dots or navigation labels).

findings.issue: Product hero image (carousel items) appears undersized and lacks visual prominence in the upper 2/3 of the frame. Image scaling and composition reduce perceived value of featured LEGO sets.
findings.fix_hint: Increase max-height and width of .carousel-item img to fill more of the available space above the yellow section (suggest 220-240px height). Use object-fit: cover and center the image container. Ensure product images are cropped to show the set clearly without excessive white space.

findings.issue: Tagline/subtitle text (e.g. 'Sèts exclusifs & collections fraîches') appears to use a serif or non-Cera Pro font, violating the style guide typography requirement. All body and supporting copy must use Cera Pro (weight 400 or 500) or Open Sans fallback.
findings.fix_hint: Apply font-family: 'Cera Pro', 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; to all tagline/subtitle elements. Verify all text nodes below the main headline use Cera Pro or Open Sans, not serif fonts. Check .tagline, .subtitle, .description selectors.

findings.issue: Carousel pagination or navigation state is not visually obvious to users. The dots below the product title ('● ● ● ●') may indicate active slide but lack clear labeling or visual feedback on which state the user is viewing.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure carousel pagination dots have distinct visual states (active dot bolder, filled, or contrasting color; inactive dots lighter or outlined). Add aria-label to carousel container indicating current slide (e.g., 'Slide 1 of 3'). Consider a brief tooltip or visual cue on first load to indicate carousel interactivity.

findings.issue: The product image quality and framing vary across carousel states (initial shows grouped bricks, animated shows lifestyle, settled shows framed photo). Inconsistent product presentation may confuse users about what is being promoted.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure each carousel item shows a clear, high-quality product image centered in the frame. If lifestyle imagery is intentional, make sure it is labeled clearly (e.g., 'Lifestyle' or 'Découvrez') to set user expectation. Standardize image dimensions and aspect ratio across all carousel slides.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
1. Increase .carousel-item img max-height to 220px and ensure object-fit: cover centers the image.
2. Change all tagline/subtitle selectors (.tagline, .subtitle, .description) to font-family: 'Cera Pro', 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 400 or 500 only.
3. Style carousel pagination dots: active dot should use #E3000B with font-weight: 700; inactive dots #A5A5A5.
4. Add aria-label='Slide X of Y' to carousel container and visible slide counter or indicator.
5. Verify product image srcset paths are correct and images load at expected resolution on 320px viewport.
